cd /workspace/submission && cat > /tmp/dev/fuzz.py <<'EOF'
import sys, json, random, ctypes, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/vendor'); sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/dev')
ctypes.CDLL('/workspace/vendor/system-libs/libz.so.1', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
from netnomos.finite import compile_job
from brute import bf_compile_job
from gen import rand_job

seed0 = int(sys.argv[1]); trials = int(sys.argv[2]); npred = int(sys.argv[3]); ntrain = int(sys.argv[4])
rng = random.Random(seed0)
bad = 0; n = 0
t0=time.time()
for trial in range(trials):
    job = rand_job(rng, npreds=npred, ntrain=ntrain, nqueries=rng.randint(1,4))
    if job is None: continue
    n += 1
    a = compile_job(job); b = bf_compile_job(job)
    if a != b:
        bad += 1
        print('MISMATCH trial', trial); print(json.dumps(job))
        print('GOT ', json.dumps(a)); print('EXP ', json.dumps(b))
        if bad >= 2: break
print(f'seed={seed0} tested={n} mismatches={bad} elapsed={time.time()-t0:.1f}s')
EOF
for s in 1 2 3; do python3 /tmp/dev/fuzz.py $s 250 20 30; done
